aboutGame.title: What is Probably Stolen Cyberpunk Shopkeeper Sim?
paragraphs: Probably Stolen Cyberpunk Shopkeeper Sim is a single-player shop management RPG set on a dystopian space station. You source goods, authenticate what suppliers hand you, haggle with customers, manage production machines, and decide how closely to work with station factions while rising rent threatens the business.

Each run begins with a trade such as gunsmith, chemist, water merchant, fence, hydroponic farmer, or rock bottom. Inspect condition and provenance, price for the customer in front of you, keep a rent buffer, and reinvest in recipes, machines, licenses, and a second product line as the shop grows.

modules.name: Probably Stolen Cyberpunk Shopkeeper Sim Beginner Guide
modules.description: Build a stable first week by choosing a trade, inspecting stock, protecting rent money, and learning one production chain at a time.

highlights.detail: Stock one cheap, reliable product line and sell it consistently to build a cash buffer.
Inspect every incoming item before paying, because supplier overstatement is a built-in trap.
Learn one production machine or recipe end to end so raw stock can become higher-margin goods.
Keep a reserve equal to your next rent payment before buying optional inventory.
Haggle on low-stakes items and accept fair offers on high-volume goods to protect reputation.
Reinvest surplus into a second product line after the current shop can cover rent.

items.question: What is Probably Stolen Cyberpunk Shopkeeper Sim?
items.answer: Probably Stolen Cyberpunk Shopkeeper Sim is a single-player shop management RPG set on a dystopian space station. You buy and appraise goods, negotiate with customers, run production machines, deal with factions, and earn enough to keep the shop ahead of rising rent.

items.question: What should I sell first in Probably Stolen Cyberpunk Shopkeeper Sim?
items.answer: A water merchant or hydroponic farmer start gives Probably Stolen Cyberpunk Shopkeeper Sim beginners a steadier first product line. Filtered water has thin margins but constant demand, while farming trades speed for a slower, more predictable production curve.

items.question: How does appraisal work in Probably Stolen Cyberpunk Shopkeeper Sim?
items.answer: Inspect the item before discussing price, test or filter consumables, authenticate rare goods, and compare the seller's story with the condition on the shelf. If you cannot classify an item in Probably Stolen Cyberpunk Shopkeeper Sim, decline the deal instead of quoting blind.

items.question: How do I make money in Probably Stolen Cyberpunk Shopkeeper Sim?
items.answer: Probably Stolen Cyberpunk Shopkeeper Sim rewards three scalable loops: buy low and resell after appraisal, craft higher-value goods through machines and recipes, and build faction standing for better access. Keep a two-payment rent buffer before taking a large inventory risk.

items.question: Can I play Probably Stolen Cyberpunk Shopkeeper Sim on Steam Deck?
items.answer: Yes. Probably Stolen Cyberpunk Shopkeeper Sim is rated Playable on Steam Deck. The mouse-only option, adjustable text size, and absence of required quick-time events make handheld stocking and haggling sessions practical.

items.question: How do I buy out my shop in Probably Stolen Cyberpunk Shopkeeper Sim?
items.answer: Build a rent buffer first, then invest in production machines, advanced licenses, and a second business. In Probably Stolen Cyberpunk Shopkeeper Sim, each purchase should pay for itself before you expand again, and the final goal is to end the rent clock with a shop buyout.
